implementation: INTEGRITY Security Services High Assurance Embedded Cryptographic Toolkit - AES-GCM
description: ISS ECT is a standards-based cryptographic toolkit providing a flexible framework to integrate encryption, digital signatures and other security mechanisms into a wide range of applications. It is designed to support multiple cryptographic providers with a single common API, easily targeted to a variety of Operating Systems.
